Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Desiderius Erasmus (author, Wikidata Q43499), died 1536; Otto Julius Bierbaum (editor, Wikidata Q64001), died 1910; Hans Holbein (illustrator, Wikidata Q48319), died 1543. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Erasmus, Desiderius, 1469-1536; Bierbaum, Otto Julius, 1865-1910 [Editor]; Holbein, Hans, 1497-1543 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Das Lob der Narrheit, 1781, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/11912034bsb. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 60%, 37%, 69% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Otto Julius Bierbaum, Hans Holbein, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
